identity.humanRefRule: Chronological, immutable, zero-padded Project R root-thread reference
identity.providerIdentity: SessionId backed by the Codex UUIDv7-shaped identifier
identity.rankRule: Mutable portfolio value order; never an identity

scope.inclusion: Root user-owned threads where source is vscode or thread_source is user
scope.exclusion: Subagent, handoff, and implementation-history sessions map to a root thread and do not receive RTH references

agent.boundary: Agent coordination and thread metadata only; implementation belongs to the owning subject lane.

bun.boundary: Runtime and type-channel observation is read-only; promotion is a separate reviewed policy change.

ci.boundary: Local bun:ci is merge authority; hosted workflows are supporting signals and may not replace it.

cli.boundary: CLI parsing and flag contracts only; domain behavior remains with the command's owning lane.

compliance.boundary: Compliance evidence and portal projection only; legal policy and credential custody remain external authorities.

domain.boundary: Own stable meaning and parsed shape; transport, persistence, and UI projections remain separate consumers.

dx.boundary: Repository pointers and project policy only; machine-wide DX defaults remain under ~/.config/dx.

identity.boundary: Branding, parsing, and mint authority only; business semantics remain in the owning domain.

operations.boundary: Operational state, jobs, and evidence only; product contracts and portal presentation stay in their lanes.

partner.boundary: Partner contracts and projections only; connector transport, runtime policy, and UI composition stay separate.

portal.boundary: Static operator surfaces and routing only; registries and domain contracts remain upstream authorities.

project.boundary: Cross-lane authority, intake, and reconciliation only; implementation is delegated to one named subject lane.

research.boundary: Evidence gathering and falsifiable recommendations only; no automatic product, policy, or baseline mutation.

security.boundary: Security controls and verification only; secrets remain in Proton Pass and are never copied into reports.

tennis.boundary: Tennis registry and integration contracts only; Project R merge authority and external worker custody remain separate.

testing.boundary: Focused and merge-proof verification only; snapshot updates and baseline promotions require their owning workflow.

tooling.boundary: Reusable developer tools only; tools must not silently become domain or release authorities.
